files.rationale: Remove a duplicate BrowserRouter -- main.jsx already provides one, and React Router throws at runtime when a Router is rendered inside another Router, which was crashing the entire app to a blank page with no error boundary to catch it.

summary: Fix: the frontend rendered a blank page due to a duplicate BrowserRouter (one in main.jsx, one added inside App.jsx by an earlier automated coding pass). React Router refuses to render a Router inside another Router and throws at runtime; with no error boundary, this crashed and unmounted the whole app. Removed the redundant wrapper from App.jsx so main.jsx is the sole Router, as originally scaffolded.
